authority.q_design_02: BLOCKED - transcript-dependent Stage motion/integration still lacks E0-A vs E0-E behavioral evidence

question: Can nonverbal action and refusal remain explicit Character-legible performance without dialogue-bubble dependence, missing-output ambiguity, technical-failure confusion, motive inference or runtime semantics?
accepted_grammar: Listening, nonverbal action and refusal can remain distinct current Stage meanings on the same Character carrier family.
Nonverbal action may be current Character performance without requiring quoted dialogue, a speech bubble or transcript-first hierarchy.
Refusal may be explicit Character agency and must not be confused with missing output, provider failure or incapacity.
Creator selection and Director opportunity remain independent from performance modality; opportunity does not require response.
Performance modality does not establish motive, emotion, relationship meaning, causal effect or acceptance.

recursive_audit.mechanical: PASS - 1600/1024/390/320 and 320 forced-colors; zero viewport/internal overflow, images or external resources.
recursive_audit.visual: PASS - wide and narrow renders preserve the same three-way modality comparison and reading order.
repairs: Removed the inherited technical-status caption class from the refusal specimen so fictional refusal does not inherit infrastructure styling.
Applied the same explicit performed-state emphasis to refusal and nonverbal action so refusal does not read as a weaker modality.
Replaced stale silence/system explanatory sections with action/refusal-specific interpretation guards and non-authority boundaries.

explicit_non_authority: No action/gesture ontology, refusal taxonomy, multimodal representation contract or final label/icon treatment is frozen.
No motive, emotion, intention, resistance, preference, incapacity or psychological interpretation is inferred.
No duration, turn length, pause interval, beat, transcript cadence, animation timing or response threshold is established.
No causal effect, accepted Take, consequence, history mutation, Scene progression or changed-opportunity semantics are established.
No transcript/provenance placement, Stage-motion successor, provider behavior, Performer semantics or Phase-D Product control is promoted.

disposition.next: Rerun consolidated Phase-2 static coverage against all eight accepted bounded studies, then fresh-reconcile Engineering before any Phase-3 entry decision.
